question:
In the given figure, O is the centre of the circle and ∠AOC = 140°. Find ∠ABC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/301f8d380401bc6bdbe43357281ed2c91b374de7070fb5f6040efd3a0b223a1a.png]
solution:
**Given** :

O is the centre of the circle

∠AOC =140°

**Calculation:**

O is the centre of the circle

Take a point D in remaining arc

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c57c0a3b0c2011d6006046240949f2502794167279b8dbbd6e72d3ff0daef38f.png] 

∠AOC = 140°

∠AOC = 2∠ADC ( Angle formed by chord at centre = twice angle formed in same arc segment)

⇒ 140° = 2∠ADC

⇒ ∠ADC = 70°

ABCD will be a cyclic quadrilateral

Sum of opposite angles of cyclic quadrilateral = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC + ∠ADC= 180°

⇒ 70° + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 110°

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
